description: Redo an existing design with a change: a different color scheme, fewer details, bolder lines, a different pose, words added or removed. Works from the design, so the result stays recognizably the same piece. Spends one from the allowance like design_item. Returns a new design_id; the old one still exists.

design_id.description: The design_id from that design's earlier result. If that result is no longer in the conversation, leave this out to use the customer's most recent design.

instruction.description: What to change, in a sentence.

visitor.description: The visitor value from an earlier answer, if there was one.

name: revise_design
title: Change a design
